scope: Assigned partition only; merge with the other partition for the final classifications.json

classifications.name: align-grid
secondary: deterministic verification in the existing UI verification stage
classifications.current: Accepts an editorial page brief and grid parameters; generates CSS/HTML and optical-alignment JS; renders with Puppeteer; directs public image hosting and publication.
classifications.rationale: Distinct design and measurement knowledge, not a scheduler or event policy.
classifications.reuse: impeccable, playwright-cli, open-claude-design when a full design workflow is wanted
classifications.adaptation: Make Swiss styling opt-in; remove Hyperagent-only tools and automatic publication; reconcile .opt-align versus scaffold selectors; verify every grid, not just the first; avoid unconditional --no-sandbox.
classifications.validation: Missing selectors and missing overlays must fail; misalign second spread and optical headline; test font fallback, widths, keyboard access and baseline sensitivity.

classifications.name: audit-code
classifications.current: Reviews changed code using churn ranking and a checklist; can fix findings; --gate describes exit verdicts and writes an audit report; --parallel creates worktrees; sets next_skill.
classifications.rationale: The source explicitly defines self-review, not an independent reviewer role.
classifications.reuse: qlty and existing project checks; parent implementation session owns self-review
classifications.adaptation: Separate judgment from executable checks; do not adopt upstream-only CONVENTIONS rules or automatic fixes; preserve the actual uncommitted diff; parent owns state.
classifications.validation: A real defect must fail the gate; check quick-mode omissions, staged/unstaged coverage, report freshness and no worktree data loss.

classifications.name: build-epic
secondary: story mode of one shared implementation workflow
classifications.current: Reads epic/state/status; performs threat-model, planning, branch, TDD, verification, audit, commit and release steps; updates cycle counters, timestamps, BCP and generated trace/wiki files.
classifications.rationale: Durable story orchestration, checkpoints and remediation belong to Atomic workflows.
classifications.reuse: goal or ralph for compatible implementation control; adversarial-verification only where its criteria fit
classifications.adaptation: Resolve epic versus story scope, step versus current_step and missing-step threat-model bypass; single state writer; use unique DAG retry nodes; do not bundle release permission or mandatory wiki sync.
classifications.validation: Resume at every step without duplicate commits or release; audit failure blocks; step zero cannot be skipped accidentally; reject concurrent status overwrites.

classifications.name: commit-message
classifications.current: Inspects Git or Jujutsu changes and intent, proposes atomic commit messages and heuristic version impact, notes defensive categories and writes a release handoff.
classifications.rationale: A user shortcut to existing commit guidance is sufficient; no new agent or release controller.
classifications.reuse: installed commit-work
classifications.adaptation: Keep draft-only mode separate from permission to stage or commit; use actual release config; retain user-only attribution and signing conventions; remove automatic next_skill writes.
classifications.validation: Mixed changes yield multiple proposed commits; draft mode leaves index/history unchanged; custom analyzer rules and breaking footers handled.

classifications.name: context7-mcp
secondary: optional existing cache, not a new extension
classifications.current: Resolves a library and queries docs within a three-call cap, emits CONTEXT7_UNAVAILABLE, and caches responses under .bigpowers/cache/docs.
classifications.rationale: Tool-use and evidence discipline, not a new MCP client implementation.
classifications.reuse: mcp discovery/describe/call and exact-version local OSS research policy
classifications.adaptation: Resolve manifest/lockfile version and its pinned checkout first; remote current docs cannot replace required local source; cache helper stores ETags but performs no revalidation HTTP itself; avoid duplicating MCP caching.
classifications.validation: Wrong-version, no-match, quota, timeout, stale cache and missing server cases remain explicit; unavailable docs never become verified training-data answers.

classifications.name: deepen-architecture
classifications.current: Explores churn and architecture, scores module depth, interviews user on candidates, edits domain vocabulary/ADRs and import-boundary declarations.
classifications.rationale: Interactive architecture judgment remains in the parent; only bounded exploration benefits from isolation.
classifications.reuse: how, codebase-analyzer, codebase-pattern-finder, code-simplifier for separately authorized changes
classifications.adaptation: Do not mandate three agents or upstream shell import policy; resolve docs/adr versus specs/adr mismatch; preserve user language and existing tests until replacement coverage is proven.
classifications.validation: Reject speculative abstractions, preserve ADR intent and behavior, compare genuinely distinct alternatives; no edits before the agreed scope.

classifications.name: define-success
classifications.current: A tombstone containing only a redirect to plan-work, retained for a transition release.
classifications.rationale: There is no independent success-definition method to port. Template classification is only a compatibility disposition.
classifications.reuse: plan-work owner and Atomic planning guidance
classifications.adaptation: Default to no new resource unless existing users need the alias; keep it out of auto-invoked skill descriptions; give the alias an expiry.
classifications.validation: Canonical inventory retains the exact name; alias resolves once without duplicate slash registration or invented behavior.

classifications.name: deploy
secondary: deployment mode of shared delivery workflow
classifications.current: Detects build command/target from manifests and environment; builds and checks nonempty output; deploys, polls, retries and probes live URL.
classifications.rationale: External mutation plus wait, verification and recovery needs an explicit delivery boundary.
classifications.reuse: Atomic durable tools, native shell/MCP and verification contracts
classifications.adaptation: Do not infer production authorization from credentials or branch; identify immutable artifact and environment; replace placeholder get_deploy_status and deploy_command; reconcile uncertain outcomes before retry; bound health requests.
classifications.validation: Declined approval makes no external change; test deployment timeout, duplicate-submit prevention, bad artifact, accepted-but-unhealthy deployment and non-200 HTTP handling.

classifications.name: develop-tdd
secondary: approved worker inside shared implementation workflow
classifications.current: Requires planned feature/bug and branch; runs vertical RED/GREEN cycles, mandates failing-test and implementation commits, stashes checkpoints, updates task/state ledgers and requests manual UAT.
classifications.rationale: TDD is an implementation discipline; its surrounding delivery state is not a separate TDD controller.
classifications.reuse: builtin tdd and worker/debugger
classifications.adaptation: Explicitly reject automatic two-commit RED policy unless separately chosen; retain real failing-test evidence without committing red; remove implicit stash/drop, sync and state mutations; fix missing CI dry-run reference.
classifications.validation: RED fails for the intended behavior, not missing dependencies; GREEN reruns same scenario; no unexpected commits/stashes; reject skipped RED checks and stale ledger evidence.

classifications.name: diagnose-stall
classifications.current: Reads state and locks, inspects terminals, classifies waits/exhaustion/I/O, recommends one recovery action and writes a stall report.
classifications.rationale: Diagnosis is useful; another idle timer or orchestration watchdog would duplicate Atomic.
classifications.reuse: owner-bound task status/wait, workflow activity, native control notices
classifications.adaptation: Distinguish waiting approval, live provider work, paused and unknown; use task IDs rather than killing arbitrary PIDs; never infer failure from elapsed silence or stale YAML alone.
classifications.validation: Long quiet provider call is not restarted; waiting approval is preserved; stop request is not reported as termination; no duplicate dispatch after reconnection.

classifications.name: edit-document
classifications.current: Reads history, divides an existing document into dependency-ordered sections, confirms structure and rewrites with a 240-character paragraph limit.
classifications.rationale: A short user-invoked editing recipe does not justify a dedicated worker, workflow or extension.
classifications.reuse: unslop; writing-for-agents; simple-english only when appropriate
classifications.adaptation: Make paragraph length a preference rather than a universal limit; preserve technical meaning, quotations and uncertainty; honor read-only CHANGELOG/generated files.
classifications.validation: Diff preserves factual claims, links, identifiers and intended obligations; prohibited files remain unchanged; structural questions use the question tool.

classifications.name: enforce-first
classifications.current: Checks F.I.R.S.T per file, offers full/quick modes, applies fixes and reruns tests; mechanical verify only checks rubric text exists.
classifications.rationale: A reusable test-quality rubric requires judgment; grep for its name is not enforcement.
classifications.reuse: tdd, qlty where relevant, project tests
classifications.adaptation: Carry rubric without importing all CONVENTIONS; make quick-mode omissions explicit; no automatic fixes in read-only reviews; use runtime tests for isolation/repeatability.
classifications.validation: Introduce order dependence, nondeterminism and missing assertions; audit must identify them; missing rubric text and actual suite failure stay distinct.

classifications.name: execute-plan
secondary: human-checkpoint mode of shared implementation workflow
classifications.current: Reads active epic tasks, interprets dependencies, spawns fresh skill contexts, executes/verifies each task, asks per-step approval and updates decisions/status.
classifications.rationale: Durable per-task human checkpoints and dependency execution belong to the runtime, not prose-driven next_skill chaining.
classifications.reuse: Atomic stages, graph-backed human input, goal only where its autonomy matches
classifications.adaptation: Carry full typed context/artifacts instead of state.yaml-only communication; parse explicit dependencies; preserve requested stop/reorder choices; bound repairs and keep release separate.
classifications.validation: Pause/resume preserves approved task order; no advancement on red; missing input and cancelled question block; unique retry identities and exact remaining work.

classifications.name: find-way
classifications.current: Creates a map issue and decision tickets with labels/dependencies; assigns work, spawns research, comments/closes tickets and graduates new decisions.
classifications.rationale: The user-led decision-map method is not a mandate for a long-running project scheduler.
classifications.reuse: todo for a local alternative; research-codebase and existing research agents
classifications.adaptation: Resolve direct conflict with upstream ban on automated issues; choose tracker versus local artifact explicitly; local todo is an adaptation, not equivalent tracker dependency semantics; remove auto-fanout and obsolete /research aliases.
classifications.validation: No tracker mutation without scope approval; refresh/claim handles concurrent edits; map creation resolves no decisions; one-ticket session rule remains visible if retained.

classifications.name: gate-trace
secondary: deterministic rule gate inside shared verification/delivery
classifications.current: Reads or regenerates trace/blind-spot inputs, applies verdict rules and confidence downgrades, invokes completeness critic, records gate and handoff.
classifications.rationale: Retain policy as reference; executable reduction belongs to a shared workflow tool, not a new global extension or one-skill workflow.
classifications.reuse: Atomic schema-backed results and explicit deterministic gates
classifications.adaptation: Define complete precedence, 60-79 percent behavior, R6 inclusion and non-improving drift logic; missing inputs are not permission to merge; separate deterministic verdict from model refutation.
classifications.validation: Truth-table every rule/threshold, simultaneous failures and corrupt/missing inputs; FAIL never upgrades to CONCERNS; critic and semantic verdict checked separately.

classifications.name: grill-me
secondary: version-grounded docs research owned by existing docs variant
classifications.current: Interactive design questioning distinguishes facts from decisions; docs mode checks API assumptions; blocks implementation/spec writing until confirmation.
classifications.rationale: A conversation-led method belongs in the parent, not a non-interactive subagent.
classifications.reuse: ask_user_question, how/why and planning discovery
classifications.adaptation: Consolidate docs-mode ownership with grill-with-docs rather than duplicate methods; independently discover facts; ask only needed decisions with choices; honor existing approval.
classifications.validation: Answerable facts do not become user questions; unresolved tradeoff blocks transition; cancelling a question is not approval; no surprise specification writes.

classifications.name: guard-git
classifications.current: Skill installs cross-client hook/settings bundles; shell helper blocks regex patterns; OMP extension adds partial branch/commit policy to bash tool_call.
classifications.rationale: Cross-cutting pre-execution blocking is the one clear extension responsibility in this partition.
classifications.reuse: Atomic tool_call interception and project trust; no built-in command allow/deny policy to claim as replacement
classifications.adaptation: Do not port the monolithic discovery/command extension; reconcile absent secret/author enforcement and inconsistent landing exemption; cover command cwd, Git -C, wrappers and native tool variants; do not promise a sandbox.
classifications.validation: Negative/positive cases for aliases, reordered flags, scripts, master default push, worktrees and protected remotes; bypass limits documented; user commands unaffected unless explicitly scoped.

classifications.name: hook-commits
classifications.current: Installs Husky/lint-staged/Prettier, writes prepare/hook/config files, runs staged formatting and automatically stages/commits setup.
classifications.rationale: A repo setup recipe should not become an Atomic event extension just because its product is a Git hook.
classifications.reuse: existing hooks, qlty and project formatter; commit-work only after commit authorization
classifications.adaptation: Inspect exact versions and existing hook manager; recognize bun.lock; preserve prepare and lint-staged configuration; remove blanket staged formatting and automatic commit.
classifications.validation: All supported package managers, existing hooks/config and absent test scripts; repeated setup is idempotent; unrelated staged files and generated files remain untouched.

classifications.name: investigate-bug
secondary: diagnose-root method via bounded inspect-only debugger
classifications.current: Reads prior bugs, assesses security impact, invokes four-phase RCA, requires verified cause, writes TDD fix plan and registry row, recommends branch creation.
classifications.rationale: A bounded investigation returns evidence and a fix plan well in isolated context; the parent retains user decisions and implementation authority.
classifications.reuse: builtin debugger with an explicit no-fix investigation scope, plus history research
classifications.adaptation: Do not use default debugger mutation behavior unchanged; parent supplies reproduction criteria and owns registry writes; retain source citations alongside durable behavioral description rather than banning paths.
classifications.validation: Reproduce original user scenario; prove root cause by falsification; uncertain cause remains blocked; no production patch, commit or duplicate bug ID.

classifications.name: maintain-wiki
classifications.current: INGEST runs broad skill/convention/agent-guide generation; LINT checks stale/orphan/contradictory concepts; QUERY searches generated OKF bundles.
classifications.rationale: Keep an optional documentation maintenance method; no background auto-sync extension is needed.
classifications.reuse: native search/read, research-codebase, existing docs build
classifications.adaptation: Separate query/lint from mutation; no generator runs under read-only generated-file policy; prefer source references if no OKF consumer; mtime is not semantic freshness.
classifications.validation: Queries never write; source deletion and stale links are reported; generator scope is explicit and idempotent in a future authorized test; no unrelated mirrors change.

classifications.name: migrate-spec
classifications.current: Detects foreign spec layouts, interviews on ambiguity, maps artifacts and IDs into specs, writes trace files and regenerates state; reference also writes CLAUDE.md.
classifications.rationale: One-off, interactive transformation fits a skill; a permanent migration controller adds little.
classifications.reuse: read/search/edit, research-codebase and existing spec validation
classifications.adaptation: Resolve never-overwrite versus regenerate-state contradiction; preserve foreign sources, active execution history and user config; present all output paths including CLAUDE.md; adapt to actual artifact layout.
classifications.validation: Multiple/partial fingerprints, mixed IDs, collisions, active work, refusal and merge choices; unchanged sources and idempotent second pass; no lost state.

classifications.name: orchestrate-project
classifications.current: Owns a six-phase lifecycle, state counters, hard gates, model-frontmatter spawning, story sequencing, confirmation and release snapshots.
classifications.rationale: This is explicit durable orchestration, but only appropriate for genuinely multi-phase projects.
classifications.reuse: Atomic workflow composition and existing goal/ralph patterns where contracts match
classifications.adaptation: Never import upstream model pins or build a second YAML scheduler; replace arbitrary time estimates and scores; reconcile per-story release versus later project verify/release; no auto-approval of external effects.
classifications.validation: Resume each phase, reject missing evidence, preserve human stops and inline override; ensure one release owner and acyclic bounded repair topology.

classifications.name: plan-refactor
classifications.current: Interviews user, validates repo assertions, captures invariants/scope/testing decisions and a tiny-green-commit refactor plan in REFACTOR_LATEST.md.
classifications.rationale: Planning and invariant discovery are a reusable parent-led method, not execution of the commits.
classifications.reuse: create-spec, how, codebase-analyzer/pattern-finder
classifications.adaptation: Keep source evidence and current paths in an appendix rather than the blanket path ban; avoid overwriting unrelated LATEST plan; no automatic branch/commit actions.
classifications.validation: Every step has a runnable behavior-preserving verify; characterize untested behavior first; out-of-scope decisions and invariants stay intact.

classifications.name: plan-tests
classifications.current: Maps epic stories to P0-P3 scenarios, test levels, fixtures and NFR commands; emits a test plan with mandatory scenario IDs and plan-work handoff.
classifications.rationale: Test architecture is reusable planning knowledge; routine invocation needs neither another workflow nor mandatory agent.
classifications.reuse: tdd, create-spec and project testing patterns
classifications.adaptation: Fix REFERENCE ID format and hardcoded e32 verify; do not silently waive required NFRs under --lite; fixture choices follow actual pinned stack; remove model pin.
classifications.validation: Scenario IDs join to stories and acceptance criteria; P0 behaviors covered; commands run in correct environment; no test or production code written during planning.

classifications.name: publish-package
secondary: registry mode of shared delivery workflow
classifications.current: Detects registry, checks prerequisites/version/build, publishes and checks registry visibility; describes dry-run and bypass options.
classifications.rationale: Irreversible external publication belongs behind explicit durable delivery gates, not automatic skill continuation.
classifications.reuse: Atomic durable tools and separate post-approval final actions
classifications.adaptation: Remove TestPyPI upload from dry-run, no-verify bypass and CHANGELOG edit instruction; specify package/version/registry/visibility; immutable artifact and reconciliation before retry; validate actual tool versions.
classifications.validation: Dry-run emits no remote write; refused approval does not publish; duplicate version, partial failure, wrong registry and stale artifact block; resumed publish is not duplicated.

classifications.name: release-branch
secondary: branch-integration mode of shared delivery workflow
classifications.current: Runs gates, selects solo/PR/keep/discard, may squash/commit/push/merge, archives epics, waits CI, removes worktrees and branches, updates release state.
classifications.rationale: Multiple external and destructive effects need a distinct authorized delivery boundary.
classifications.reuse: Atomic final-action separation, durable tools, native Git/gh and existing commit-work
classifications.adaptation: No solo default when unsure; independently authorize commit/push/PR/merge/tag/publish/cleanup; no auto force-remove; fix CI-unverified success and cancelled-run handling; audit landing fallback status.
classifications.validation: Decline each action; dirty worktree preserved; protected-branch rejection, failed push, cancelled CI and missing gh never report released; no replayed mutations.

classifications.name: research-first
secondary: existing codebase and online research agents
classifications.current: Searches repo, skills, package registries, opensrc cache and web; records adopt/extend/compose/build decision in scope/story notes.
classifications.rationale: Prior-art selection is a reusable evidence method, not a new search engine or control flow.
classifications.reuse: research-codebase, codebase-online-researcher, native web/code/MCP tools
classifications.adaptation: Replace opensrc/npx fallback with required exact-version OSS checkouts; inspect native skill catalog rather than regenerate a Bigpowers index; do not append Markdown syntax into YAML incorrectly.
classifications.validation: Candidates have exact versions and source links; unavailable evidence stays explicit; no package installs or generated index writes; decision explains why existing capability is insufficient.

classifications.name: respond-review
secondary: bounded repair stage of shared implementation workflow
classifications.current: Reads all findings, classifies must/should/consider, asks on design suggestions, applies fixes, reruns suite and reports dispositions.
classifications.rationale: Feedback handling is a method; control/retry stays with the existing review loop.
classifications.reuse: goal/ralph repair contracts, worker and debugger
classifications.adaptation: Reproduce disputed bugs before fixing; preserve original acceptance criteria; record fix/disagree/defer decisions for all findings; do not infer commit or merge authorization.
classifications.validation: No silently dropped finding; skipped fixes have reasons; tests run on final candidate; architecture decisions return to parent; no contract drift across rounds.

classifications.name: run-evals
secondary: deterministic repeated checks in existing verification workflow
classifications.current: Defines capability/regression evals, grader type, stability tiers and promotion rules; repeats runs, reports pass@k and blocks required failures.
classifications.rationale: The useful part is evaluation design; native tools and existing workflows can execute repetitions.
classifications.reuse: skill-creator/prompt-engineer where applicable; Atomic verification and adversarial-verification only with a matching rubric
classifications.adaptation: Rename successes/k and all-k reliability instead of misusing pass@k; align tier wording and fixtures; calibrate model graders; preserve individual runs and flake history.
classifications.validation: Seed known regressions and grader mistakes; expected tier transitions and missing-run handling; failed required eval blocks; no model-selected score substitutes for command status.

classifications.name: scope-work
classifications.current: Reads planning context and prior specs, interviews for goal/exclusions/constraints, writes bounded SCOPE_LATEST.yaml and maps in-scope work to future story IDs.
classifications.rationale: Reusable scope definition belongs with planning knowledge, not a separate workflow for each artifact.
classifications.reuse: create-spec and native question tool
classifications.adaptation: Preserve existing user answers and paths; resolve product versus requirements layout; allow explicit deferred mappings before IDs exist; avoid introducing mandatory Bigpowers YAML in every project.
classifications.validation: Each requirement is observable and mapped/deferred; exclusions have reasons; no implementation detail masquerades as user need; existing scope is not clobbered.

classifications.name: security-review
classifications.current: Resolves git diff, researches security context, traces dataflow, filters confidence/exclusions, writes findings or epic threat model; uses detached review worktree helper.
classifications.rationale: An independent, bounded security assessment benefits from isolated context; it must not own remediation or release permission.
classifications.reuse: compose native analyzer/research/debugger-inspect roles; Atomic has no generic bundled security reviewer
classifications.adaptation: Replace unsafe blanket exclusions for prompt injection/docs/ReDoS/Rust/etc.; do not hide uncertain high-impact findings; explicit base/head/uncommitted patch; threat modeling must work before code exists; correct unsafe guidance examples.
classifications.validation: Positive/negative fixtures plus prompt injection, path-prefix collision, unsafe Rust/FFI, operational abuse and uncommitted-only vulnerabilities; reports bound to exact diff; exceptions need human sign-off.

classifications.name: session-state
secondary: optional explicit export of durable domain decisions
classifications.current: Loads/updates state.yaml, Git identity, handoff, cycle counters and user-preference fences; resets active IDs and archives open decisions to ADRs.
classifications.rationale: Native sessions/workflow checkpoints replace execution bookkeeping; retain only handoff hygiene as an optional skill.
classifications.reuse: Atomic session persistence, compaction, workflow artifacts and todo
classifications.adaptation: No second state scheduler or automatic AGENTS/CLAUDE preference mutation; reconcile active_epic versus active_epic_id and counter formats; do not clear unresolved decisions by archiving; one writer for exports.
classifications.validation: Resume/compaction preserves open questions and approvals; stale Git state prompts clarification; concurrent writers cannot overwrite; no instruction-file edits without scope.

classifications.name: simple-english
classifications.current: Classifies procedural/descriptive text, applies pragmatic/strict STE limits, preserves code, rewrites modals, runs heuristic lint and optionally Vale; disclaims formal compliance.
classifications.rationale: Substantial language guidance and references justify a skill, not automatic rewriting of every response.
classifications.reuse: unslop and writing-for-agents; existing docs lint
classifications.adaptation: Opt in to STE; preserve requirement strength and uncertainty; do not call regex checks complete compliance; respect licensed dictionary boundary; distinguish technical terms such as parameter and argument.
classifications.validation: Commands/identifiers/quotes unchanged, may versus must meaning preserved, strict/pragmatic reports explicit; missing Vale and parser limits reported; no false compliance claim.

classifications.name: slice-tasks
secondary: parent-owned planning graph and task ledger
classifications.current: Cuts scoped work into vertical stories/tasks, assigns BCP and requirement deltas, updates epic manifests/release ordering and runnable verification fields.
classifications.rationale: Vertical slicing is planning method; task scheduling belongs to the shared implementation workflow.
classifications.reuse: create-spec, todo and existing workflow dependency contracts
classifications.adaptation: Resolve 1-13 BCP shortcut versus canonical element-sum method; sizing optional and calibrated; do not infer elapsed time from points; keep requirements and execution state ownership distinct.
classifications.validation: Each slice demonstrates user value end-to-end; dependencies acyclic; IDs/verify commands valid; before/after deltas and requirement coverage preserved.

classifications.name: spike-prototype
secondary: optional bounded worker in isolated scratch space
classifications.current: Defines question/timebox with user, writes throwaway experimental code, records outcomes/evidence/unknowns, deletes experiment and hands learning to planning.
classifications.rationale: Experiment discipline is reusable; a dedicated always-on prototype agent or workflow is unnecessary.
classifications.reuse: worker or debugger for one bounded experiment; native task lifetime controls
classifications.adaptation: Ignore production polish, not security/credentials/permissions; no automatic deletion outside owned scratch scope; preserve useful evidence; no implicit production integration or new plan execution.
classifications.validation: Timebox and scope enforced; unanswered is a valid outcome; original files unchanged; no production credentials/external side effects; cleanup touches only owned scratch artifacts.

classifications.name: survey-context
secondary: optional locator role for large context
classifications.current: Reads conventions/specs/CLAUDE and VCS, validates YAML, maps lifecycle, suggests next skill, writes timing and story-start state; absorbed list-epics/check-gates.
classifications.rationale: Context selection remains useful, while native status replaces lifecycle inference and mandatory startup scripting.
classifications.reuse: research-codebase, how, native skill catalog/task/workflow status
classifications.adaptation: Read RULES/AGENTS first; distinguish Git/Jujutsu correctly; no mandatory state initialization; do not overwrite a dynamic recommendation with unconditional plan-work handoff; do not revive ship-epic alias.
classifications.validation: No-spec project works; stale/contradictory state blocks assumptions; Jujutsu detached Git HEAD not misread; status-only invocation writes nothing.

classifications.name: trace-requirement
classifications.current: Extracts story IDs, searches code/test tags, writes coverage/dark/orphan matrix and recommends planning gaps.
classifications.rationale: Trace interpretation is reusable policy; computation belongs to tools, not a separate reviewer agent or global hook.
classifications.reuse: Atomic acceptance matrices, native search and versioned verification artifacts
classifications.adaptation: Explicit tags are provenance, not proof of implementation; align numeric versus eNNsYY IDs; preserve generated matrix ownership; avoid mandatory comment pollution where native acceptance links suffice.
classifications.validation: Missing tags, orphan tags, false filename links, archived stories and stale evidence; coverage denominator and oracle confidence explicit; no tag-only false pass.

classifications.name: validate-contracts
classifications.current: Defines schema/key-set/shape contracts, invokes shell runner and repairs mismatches; actual runner only checks top-level reference keys are present in target and skips unsupported types with exit zero.
classifications.rationale: Contract design and interpretation are reusable knowledge; validation should use existing project tooling.
classifications.reuse: existing schema/API/migration tests and Atomic durable verification tools
classifications.adaptation: Resolve subset-direction mismatch, implement or explicitly block unsupported modes, avoid grep YAML parsing and path interpolation; parameterize consumer root; freshness based on contract changes, not a universal 30-day rule.
classifications.validation: Exact/subset direction, nested keys, malformed YAML/JSON, quoted paths, missing files and schema/shape unsupported cases cannot pass vacuously.

classifications.name: verify-work
classifications.current: Runs preflight, task checks, cold start, build/types/lint/tests, security/trace/NFR checks and user UAT; repeats gap closure and writes evidence/status.
classifications.rationale: Multiphase verification with human checkpoints and repairs belongs in the shared workflow, not hidden prose loops.
classifications.reuse: Atomic verification guidance, qlty, playwright-cli, terminal tooling under its permissions; adversarial-verification where contract fits
classifications.adaptation: Resolve mandatory UAT versus P2/P3 skips; never weaken project-required checks; no pkill or blanket cache deletion; bind evidence to final candidate; deterministic checks are not model scores.
classifications.validation: Single contiguous run receipts, user scenario, skip labels, terminal exit status, high-risk blockers and stale evidence; stop/resume does not duplicate side effects; failed verify-pattern changes require review.

classifications.name: wire-ci
classifications.current: Detects forge/stack and copies bundled template; docs promise validate/dry-run; actual runner accepts detect/plan/apply/self-test and writes to package root unless WIRE_CI_TARGET set.
classifications.rationale: CI configuration is an occasional setup method, not an Atomic runtime extension or dedicated workflow.
classifications.reuse: project CI, qlty and native shell verification
classifications.adaptation: Preserve existing workflow files; parameterize consumer root; implement or remove unsupported flags; never treat gh workflow run as dry-run; avoid automatic release jobs and unexpected permission/secrets changes.
classifications.validation: Unknown/unsupported forge writes nothing; existing CI unchanged without explicit replacement; actual validation modes exercised; no remote dispatch or registry publish in local checks.

classifications.name: write-document
classifications.current: Chooses ADR/context/guide/README artifact, applies BMAD writing rules, adds verify commands and nested GEMINI indexes, may compact state and run broad skill sync.
classifications.rationale: Artifact selection and durable documentation guidance merit a skill; no separate writing scheduler is needed.
classifications.reuse: unslop, writing-for-agents, create-spec for planned changes, how/why for architecture
classifications.adaptation: Keep factual uncertainty rather than force strong claims; drop arbitrary 94 percent label, mandatory 300-line compaction, placeholders and GEMINI index proliferation; no generated/CHANGELOG edits or sync; correct template paths and commit examples.
classifications.validation: Purpose and audience clear; cited claims, runnable examples and links verified; no invented project settings; read-only files unchanged; absent details remain labeled unknown.
